executable_profile_v0_1.certificate_producer: Untrusted C0 producer that binds exact source hashes, evidence spans, protocol/implementation identities, canonical-signature digest, closed read-set receipt, semantic slice, and producer-kernel result.
executable_profile_v0_1.producer_kernel: Pure deterministic finite semantic-slice evaluator for admissions A-F, preregistered A3/A4 constructive witnesses, preservation obligations, and finite CTV world relation. It parses no source and is untrusted for C1.

canonical consequence-signature bundle derived only from frozen canonical seeds
production closed read-set policy/receipt and exact execution harness
prospectively frozen C1 local models for any helper-control or non-Python coverage intentionally claimed
